component.name: OpenXplorer
component.summary: Explorer-style local and SMB file manager

description.p: Browse local files and SMB shares in a tabbed interface with light and dark appearances, a resizable sidebar, indexed filename search and read-only ZIP browsing.

This development release adds connected network locations, searchable Settings, tab-to-window movement and opt-in Show in folder integration for Zorin desktops. Installation does not change file associations, browser preferences or network mounts.

Middle-click folders to open tabs in the background. Restore tab tear-out with the desktop-drop handshake and an explicit source-window drop area, while retaining cross-window merging. Existing defaults remain unchanged until requested.
